name: What are common design considerations for a functional home office addition?

mainEntity.name: What are common design considerations for a functional home office addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common design considerations for a functional home office include adequate natural and artificial lighting, ergonomic layout for furniture, and sufficient electrical outlets for technology. Consider sound insulation if the office is near high-traffic areas in your home, and incorporate built-in storage to keep the space organized. Discussing these specific functional needs early in the design phase helps tailor the space to your workflow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Focus on lighting, ergonomic layout, electrical needs, and sound insulation. Built-in storage is also crucial for functionality.
